item.title: LumePane 9.0.9
item.description: 性能 • Glass Orb idle CPU: on this Mac, 19–25% before, now about 2–6% while active and near 0% when the app is in the background. • Idle orb rendering is 24fps; charge/drag interactions still use 60fps. • The Metal renderer pauses when the app resigns active and resumes when it becomes active again. • Removed the infinite SwiftUI shadow animation on the idle orb; it now uses a static glow while the shader supplies the motion. 质量 • No feature or licence-flow changes. Existing DP- legacy codes and LP- codes remain accepted. • Release gate: conventions, localisation, claims, pricing, site links, 208 server tests, and all nine app self-tests.
